title: A Newport Christmas
description: A socialite from 1905 is swept to 2025, where she falls in love and must choose between a new future and preserving the life she left behind.

title: A Very Vermont Christmas
description: A local champion skier and Vermont brew master teams up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

title: Three Wiser Men And A Boy
description: The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.

title: An Alpine Holiday
description: Estranged sisters Faith and Kelly reunite to fulfil their grandmother's last wish as they travel to the French Alps for Christmas, bonding and finding love along the way.

title: Our Holiday Story
description: A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.

title: Trivia At St Nick's
description: At a local bar's trivia tournament at the end of the semester, two mismatched students team up to win the coveted prize - and fall in love along the way.

title: Trading Up Christmas
description: Keri desperately needs a new home and her sister Michelle hatches a plan to help. With only a Christmas stocking, she sets out to trade her way up to something far greater-a house.

title: Holiday Heritage
description: Join Ella, her mum and her grandma in this countdown-to-Christmas romcom, as three generations celebrate two holidays - Christmas and Kwanzaa - as one family.

title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
description: An ambitious reporter looking for her big break and an impetuous prince sent to New York on assignment have their worlds collide during the holidays.

title: The Christmas Bookshop
description: The story of a structured Christmas expert and a laid-back bookstore owner who clash, but their rivalry blossoms into a heart-warming romance.

title: Christmas At The Catnip Cafe
description: Olivia, discovers her late great aunt's cat café, which she believes will be a Christmas miracle. Helping plan fundraising events, gaining appreciation for the feline inhabitants.

title: Deck The Halls On Cherry...
description: Three generations on Cherry Lane experience life-changing Christmases, from a mistaken address leading to a live TV special, to a family facing their last holiday together.

title: Christmas With A Kiss
description: Romance ignites after a woman returns home to help with her family's Christmas Carnival.

title: A Carol For Two
description: When talented singer Violette takes a job as a waitress in New York, things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

title: Holiday Unplugged
description: A screen-free Christmas helps Sally reconnect with her family and find new love, as they learn to cherish old memories and make new ones.

title: Christmas Above The Clouds
description: Eager to avoid Christmas, Ella, a CEO, books an international trip that skips the holiday, until spirits journey Ella through her life to rediscover her Christmas spirit.

title: Mistletoe In Montana
description: Cowgirl Merry has been unlucky in love, but is she right to hope that her fortunes have changed when single dad Mark gallops onto her ranch and lassoes her heart.

title: Mystery On Mistletoe Lane
description: Heidi discovers a Christmas mystery in her historic home. Local handyman and historian David helps along the way, finding his own surprising connection.

title: Tidings For The Season
description: A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum, but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.
